target_identity_incident.observation: Initial CUA binding selected an already-running default instance (22092), rather than the diagnostic instance (10335). Its initially blank tabs were used for a synthetic fixture navigation and an additional blank tab before mismatch was detected. These actions are excluded from diagnostic evidence. No personal page contents or profile files were inspected.
target_identity_incident.resolution: Normal menu Quit retired 22092; process inventory then showed only owned diagnostic Aelo 10335. Rebinding made native actions correlate with diagnostic CDP and lifecycle events.
target_identity_incident.abandoned_alternative: A uniquely identified disposable bundle copy had unchanged framework bytes but REA spawn initialization timed out. No copy process remained and no qualification uses it.
